title: Splash at the Duck Pond
retell: Tell me what Pip wanted, what went wrong, and how the ducks helped.

pages.text: Pip the cat sits on the bank of a big pond.
Ducks are in the pond. Quack! Quack! They splash and dip.
Pip has a wish. "I wish I had a ship," she said.
Gus the duck swims up. "I can help," said Gus. "Get into my nest."
The nest is a fun ship. Pip sits in it. Gus tugs it with his bill.
Then the wind gets up. Swish! The nest rocks. Pip hangs on.
Splash! Pip is in the mud. She is wet and sad.
Beth the duck and all the ducks rush to her. They tug and tug.
Pip is on the bank. "Thanks!" she said. "Next, I will just fish!"

options: She was wet and in the mud

questions.q: Would you ride in a duck nest? Why?
